lead.title: Undecimal Bio launches with an $18M seed to take siRNA beyond the liver
lead.deck: Spin-out of Eleven Therapeutics (Cambridge, UK, and Tel Aviv) led by CEO Yaniv Erlich, the company screens large compound libraries for molecules that attach to siRNA and carry it into target cells (kidney and vascular first). Seed co-led by 4BIO Capital and IQ Capital, with Verve Ventures, Harel Tech, Entrée Capital, Kerna Ventures and Saras Capital.

milestone.title: Petrelintide (Zealand/Roche): 7.4% to 9.2% weight loss at 28 weeks in ZUPREME-2 in obese patients with type 2 diabetes
milestone.summary: All three dose arms met the primary endpoint in 220 participants (placebo: 2.0%), with placebo-adjusted HbA1c reductions of 0.61 to 0.88 points and GI discontinuations of 1.9% vs 1.7% on placebo.
milestone.why: The amylin analog is the class trying to rival GLP-1s on tolerability; Roche has already started the Phase 3a program with Zealand.

deal.thesis: The Paris biotech signs a Pfizer deal worth over $500M (upfront undisclosed, milestones and royalties included) on machine-learning-designed small molecules that modulate the Sec61 translocon to block disease-driving proteins at the point of synthesis. The platform combines proteomics, cryo-EM and AI-assisted design.

brefsEurope.title: Beactica selects BEA-28, a TEAD degrader, as its preclinical candidate
brefsEurope.summary: Tumor regression seen in mouse models of mesothelioma and KRAS-mutant lung cancer; human testing is still ahead.

brefsEurope.title: Rewind Therapeutics secures additional funding for its oral GPR17 antagonist in multiple sclerosis
brefsEurope.summary: Amount and investors undisclosed; the funds support studies ahead of first-in-human for this remyelination approach.

brefsEurope.title: iOnctura publishes two Nature Communications papers on roginolisib (PI3Kδ inhibitor)
brefsEurope.summary: In 44 patients with advanced cancers, no dose-limiting toxicities; encouraging survival signals in metastatic uveal melanoma, randomized Phase 2 data pending.

word.definition: A two-headed molecule that tethers a disease-driving protein to the cell's disposal machinery, which destroys it instead of merely blocking it.

parts.label: Target ligand
parts.role: the hook onto the disease protein

parts.label: Linker
parts.role: the bridge between the two heads

parts.label: E3 ligase ligand
parts.role: the call to the destruction machinery

how.t: One head binds the disease protein, the other an E3 ligase.
The ligase tags the protein with ubiquitin.
The proteasome destroys the tagged protein and the molecule can start again.

word.why: Opens targets that are 'undruggable' by classic inhibition; the VC angle is a maturing modality class with young clinical proof and pharma licensing as the exit path.

startups.name: Amphista Therapeutics
startups.use: University of Dundee spin-out (Alessio Ciulli lab) specialized in targeted degraders; first patient dosed in Phase 1 with AMX-883.

startups.name: Captor Therapeutics
startups.use: Targeted protein degradation platform in oncology and autoimmunity, with labs in Wrocław and a hub in Basel.
